changelog: 100,000+ Transaction Support: Scale your imports effortlessly with expanded capacity built to handle massive datasets without performance slowdowns.
🔒 Intelligent Sheet Protection: Header titles and merged cells (Rows 1 & 2) are locked against accidental editing while keeping everyday Excel features completely active:
🔽 Filter & Sort Arrows: Clickable filter dropdowns on every column header in Row 2 let you filter by Date, Voucher Type, Ledger Name, Amount, and more.
📏 Resizable Columns & Rows: Widths and heights can be adjusted freely.
➕ Insert & Delete Rows/Columns: Full support for Ctrl + + and Ctrl + - shortcuts.
♾️ Unlocked Data Entry: Rows 3 and beyond, as well as extra columns, remain 100% unlocked with zero recovery prompts or entry limits.
2K Direct Posting Batches: Direct live-posting processes in optimal 2,000-record chunks for maximum speed and stability.
10K XML Export Batches: XML generation handles up to 10,000 records per batch for lightning-fast file saving.
Bug Fixes & Optimizations: General under-the-hood stability tweaks for smoother overall operation.
